name: Camarillasaurus
isnote: Described in 2014 as a ceratosaur (Sanchez-Hernandez and Benton 2014); later work cited in the article treats it as a spinosaurid, and PBDB places it in Spinosaurinae.
sum: Barremian theropod from Camarillas, Teruel, Spain, described in 2014 and later reinterpreted as a spinosaurid.
holotype: Not given in the sources used.
material: Not given in the sources used.
